text: The official CLI securely retrieves secrets and other items for use in scripts, deployments, and CI/CD pipelines
quote: the CLI enables you to securely retrieve secrets and other items across scripts, deployments, and continuous integration/ continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.

text: The CLI injects credentials into scripts and pipelines without exposing secrets in plaintext, shell, logs, or command history
quote: With Proton Pass CLI, credentials can be injected directly into scripts, deployments, and CI/CD pipelines without exposing secrets in plaintext, shell, logs, or command history.

text: Works in CI/CD, servers, containers, and headless environments
quote: Work in CI/CD, servers, containers, and headless environments

text: Create, read, update, and delete vaults
quote: Create, read, update, and delete vaults

text: View, create, update, and delete items, including passwords, notes, cards, identities, WiFi, custom items, and SSH keys
quote: View, create, update, and delete items including passwords, secure notes, credit cards, identities, WiFi entries, custom items, and stored SSH-key items

text: Import passwords and other items from most major password managers in minutes
quote: With our import tool, you can migrate passwords and other items from most major password managers in just a few minutes.

text: Import a PGP-encrypted ZIP export directly into Proton Pass
quote: You can import a PGP-encrypted ZIP file directly into Proton Pass (see below).

text: Export data as a PGP-encrypted JSON ZIP, an unencrypted ZIP, or a CSV file
quote:
You have three options for export:

1.  A ZIP file containing a PGP-encrypted JSON file
2.  An unencrypted ZIP file
3.  A CSV file

text: Export is available from the browser extensions, the web app, and the Windows app
quote: You can export your data from Proton Pass via our browser extensions, web app, and Windows app.

text: Generates TOTP codes for saved logins, so no separate authenticator app is needed
quote: Instead of requiring a separate [authenticator app](/blog/authenticator-app), Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.

text: Pass Monitor scans the dark web for credential leaks, checks password health, and reminds you to enable 2FA
quote: Pass Monitor is a security feature in Proton Pass that scans the dark web for credential leaks, checks on the health of your passwords, and reminds you to switch on two-factor authentication (2FA) for accounts where it’s available.

text: Alerts you to weak passwords, reused passwords, and inactive 2FA
quote: Here we alert you of any weak passwords, reused passwords, or inactive 2FA.

text: Checks for breaches of your Proton addresses, email aliases, and custom emails
quote: Here, you can check for breaches of your Proton addresses, email aliases, and custom emails.

text: Items can be excluded from monitoring alerts and revisited later
quote: This will place the item in the **excluded items** category, where you can revisit it later.

text: Proton Sentinel combines AI and human analysis to protect against account takeover
quote: Proton Sentinel is an advanced account protection program that provides maximum security for those who need it. It mitigates security threats by combining AI with human analysis.

text: Stores passkeys and uses them to sign you into websites without passwords
quote: Next time you access the site, Proton Pass will prompt you to enter using your passkey.

text: Supports multiple passkeys for the same site and lets you choose which one to use
quote: Note that you can have multiple passkeys for the same site; they will all be displayed in the same pop-up, and you can choose which to use.

text: All vault contents are accessible offline without any setup
quote: You don’t need to do anything to access Proton Pass offline. Everything in your vaults is accessible whether you’re connected to the internet or not.

text: End-to-end encrypts every field of stored items, including usernames and website addresses
quote: Unlike other password managers, Proton Pass uses end-to-end encryption on every field you fill for the items you create (usernames, website addresses, and more).

text: Stores, shares, and autofills credentials
quote: Securely store, share, and autofill your credentials with Proton Pass, the end-to-end encrypted password manager trusted by millions.

text: Use vaults to organize items, for example separate personal and work vaults
quote: Vaults can be used to organize items — in the example above, we have a vault for personal items and one for work items.
